title: Carrying Things up the Mountain+mandolin
lyrics:
(Oh...oh...oh...oh...)
(Walking up and down regularly)
(Porters still walk up and down)
(Hmm..hmm..hmm..hmm..)

Porters are a regular job. They do it.
Carrying things up the mountain
The regular job of the Srithan people
Going up and down is not an easy job.

Walking up Phu Kradueng is difficult.
Carrying heavy is extremely difficult.
Doing this job for the income.
Save it for spending, buying food.

Not long now, the cable car will arrive.
Take the cable car instead of walking.
The old way of walking will probably end.
No one will do this job anymore.

Porters are a regular job, doing it
Oh, is it time to stop carrying?
Please divide the proportions of this job
Keep it for the people of Srithan..

Not long now, the cable car will arrive.
Take the cable car instead of walking.
The old way of walking will probably end.
No one will do this job anymore.

Porters are a regular job, doing it
Oh, is it time to stop carrying?
Please divide the proportions of this job
Keep it for the people of Srithan..

Keep it for the people of Srithan..
(Hmm..hmm..hmm..hmm..)
****************
